name: Oligio

card.summary: A Korean radiofrequency device line from Wontech used in clinics for skin tightening and lifting treatments.
card.note: A clinic-operated medical device; the maker's page lists no published efficacy data.

quick.overview:
Oligio is a line of radiofrequency (RF) energy devices from Wontech Co., Ltd. of Seongnam, Korea. Clinics use them for skin tightening and lifting treatments of the face.

The aim is firmer-looking skin and a tighter facial contour. The newest model combines RF and ultrasound energy, and the maker describes delivery at depths from the surface to the SMAS layer, with cooling.
quick.how: A practitioner passes a handpiece with a replaceable tip over the treated area. The maker lists tips of 0.25 cm2 and 4 cm2. The oligio xm model also has a focused-ultrasound mode registered for eyebrow lifting.
quick.risks: Energy-based devices can cause redness, swelling or burns if misused, which is why they are used by trained practitioners. The three models are listed by the maker as medical devices with Korean permit numbers.

lead: Oligio is a Korean line of aesthetic energy devices made by Wontech Co., Ltd. of Seongnam, Gyeonggi-do. The range includes oligio, oligio x and oligio xm; the latest, oligio xm, combines high-frequency (RF) and ultrasound energy.[1]

The maker describes depth-based delivery from the surface layer down to the SMAS layer, with a cooling system and interchangeable 0.25 cm2 and 4 cm2 tips.[1] Clinics offer the treatments for skin tightening and lifting; the only specific use named on the maker's page is focused ultrasound eyebrow lifting on the xm model.[1]

All three are listed as medical devices with Korean permits. oligio xm is classified as a general electrosurgical device for high-frequency tissue coagulation and as a focused ultrasound stimulation system for eyebrow lifting.[1] The maker's page gives no clinical results.

chain: RF and ultrasound energy delivered at set depths
Tighter, lifted look in the treated area
angle.text: It is used in clinics to tighten the look of facial skin and lift areas such as the brow. The claimed result is firmer skin and sharper contour.

paras: Wontech says the RF and ultrasound components have different energy characteristics and that each device is designed around its operating method, with delivery from the superficial layer to the SMAS and a cooling system.[1]

Permit numbers listed on the maker's site are 제허 20-396호 for oligio, 제허 23-860호 for oligio x and 제허 23-885호 for oligio xm.[1] The xm combines electrosurgical high-frequency tissue coagulation with focused ultrasound for eyebrow lifting.[1]
